- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

## V.3
- **EMET:** "Also he walked in-ways-of house-of Ahab for his-mother was his-counselor to-act-wickedly."

- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.
